title: Gurgling in his throat and shaking his head
html_source:
Mulligan is purposefully obnoxious and boisterous here, temperaments that starkly contrast with Dedalus' reserved attitude.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: He is play-acting as though the mere sight of Dedalus causes demonic possession.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Perhaps, also, he is also ironically mocking the “speaking in tounges” that some zealous Christians believe may possess them.
